messages:
sam_k: Hey team — scheduling the Orbit private VPC cutover this Thu 2026-04-08 01:00 UTC (Wed 6pm PST). Slot requested by customer, 90m window.

maya: I'm OOO Thu morning, can we shift an hour later? 02:00 UTC works for me.

liam: 02:00 UTC is fine. I'll be on-call and will own rollback.

anya: I'll run smoke tests and cert checks. Can someone confirm DB migration plan? :eyes:

sam_k: DB migration is a non-blocking schema update, no downtime. Script: 
```
./migrate --target orbit_db --patch add_shard_index
```
Runs in <2min on staging. Rollback is `migrate --rollback latest`.

ops-bot: Reminder: VPC peering change requires firewall rule update (ingress from 10.40.0.0/16). See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-peering

liam: I'll apply firewall rule 5m before cutover and verify connectivity. @maya can you confirm KMS key access for Orbit service account?

maya: Confirmed — orbit-service-sa has decrypt perms on key `projects/redwood/keys/orbit-key`. I rotated creds yesterday.

anya: Smoke checklist (I'll post results in thread):
- auth + token exchange
- model endpoint warmup (single-token)
- sample prompt end-to-end
- latency p95 under 350ms

sam_k: CI is green on latest deployment branch. Tagging release: `orbit-cutover-20260408-02z`

liam: During cutover I'll watch these logs: `orbit-proxy`, `inference-runner`, `kv-cache`. If errors spike, I'll trigger rollback.

maya: Who's on standby for customer comms? I can handle reaching out and confirming maintenance start/finish.

sam_k: Thanks. Final plan:
- 01:55 UTC: pre-checks and smoke on staging
- 02:00 UTC: apply firewall + toggle routes
- 02:02 UTC: deploy release tag to private cluster
- 02:05-02:20 UTC: smoke tests (anya)
- 02:25 UTC: finalize and tell customer
- Rollback window open until 03:30 UTC

anya: ACK. I'll paste smoke results and a quick script for smoke run:
```
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://orbit.private/api/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'; done
```

liam: I'll be at my desk, pager on. Ping me in thread or DM if something odd.

maya: I'll post start + finish messages to the customer. GL everyone :rocket:

ops-bot: Scheduled: Orbit cutover (02:00 UTC) created by sam_k. Notify: @oncall, @support

sam_k: small request — can @maya or @anya capture the first 15mins of logs and attach them to the deployment ticket 6789? helps for postmortem.

maya: Will do. I'll attach logs to #ticket-6789 when done.

liam: All set from infra side. See you Thu 02:00 UTC.
